decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal, due to its excessive bulk, scale, size and inappropriate design, would harm the street scene and appearance of the area and the host property itself. It is therefore not considered to comply with adopted Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations) or the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposal, due to its excessive bulk, scale, size and inappropriate design, would harm the living conditions of the detached neighbour. It is therefore not considered to comply with adopted Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture) and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations) or the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of a part single part two storey front / side extension following the demolition of the existing garage to the house
